biotools.summary: HistoMetriX is a quantitative histology and digital pathology image analysis software for biomedical research. It enables AI-assisted tissue segmentation, cell detection and classification, biomarker quantification, morphological and intensity measurements, and spatial analysis from brightfield and fluorescence microscopy images, including whole-slide images and tissue microarrays. Custom deep-learning models can be trained to identify tissue structures and biological phenotypes specific to a study.
